scope: Search a new small full-joint conditional-copy LP for a possible global entropy upper-bound proposal. This is not a replay, variant, repair or acceptance of the frozen affine-plane archive or common-local-information packet.
permitted_input: Literal original graph N and the new conditional-product copy recipe below. No f161/f162 held consumer, f235/f236 reviewer/checker output, old bulk archive coefficient/coverage data, prior scientific PASS or affine-plane theorem is an input.

primary_graph_source.location: Gurpinar2024 Fig2 printedp570; graph definition only, no copy LP imported

over_definition: O_c is the original-vertex complement of excluded_c; it has7 vertices and omits old_c. Introduce one variable U_c with the alphabet of X_old_c.
copy_existence_written_proof: For any original finite law P(x), set P(x,u)=P(x)*product_c P(X_old_c=u_c | X_Oc=x_Oc), choosing arbitrary normalized kernels at null conditioning values. For each c, the U_c kernel depends only on X_Oc and its noise is independent of the original variables and all other copy noises. Therefore (X_Oc,U_c) has the same marginal law as (X_Oc,X_old_c), and U_c is conditionally independent of ALL original variables outside O_c and ALL other copies given X_Oc. This is a simultaneous product-kernel construction, not an unsupported strengthening of sequential copies.
exact_relaxation_rows: ALL elemental Shannon CMIs and full conditional entropies on the one joint tuple of10 originals plus every new copy, with no omitted mixed-copy branches.
For each c and EVERY A subset O_c, H(X_A,U_c)-H(X_A,X_old_c)=0, including A empty.
For each c, H(X_Oc,U_c)+H(all variables except U_c)-H(all variables)-H(X_Oc)=0.

Optional redundant copied-FD row: rename old_c to U_c in an original FD only if its entire family is contained in O_c union {old_c}; this follows from the marginal matches, not a stronger local graph FD.
normalization: H(X_v)<=1 only for the10 original vertices; maximize H(X_V). This is a relaxation of any original FD law after division by its maximal singleton entropy. Zero maximal singleton entropy is the trivial constant-law case.
symmetry: Generate the8 graph automorphisms from (8,10,7,6,9,3,4,1,2,5) and (1,5,6,7,2,3,4,8,9,10). Keep only those preserving the literal set of(old,O) copy descriptors. Extend each to copies by that descriptor permutation. Verify graph/action closure and use entropy-coordinate orbit averaging; no factor-list symmetry is needed for this graph-only copy model.

first_bounded_search.RAM_admission_estimate: under1GiB; report observed peak RSS separately; no independently tested OS enforcement claim

output_boundary: Numerical solver status/objective/primal/dual values are proposals only, NOT exact bounds, witnesses, scientific PASS or adoption. The script runs no exact certificate reconstruction or independent scientific replay. Any possible full-target numerical value at or below20/3 is frozen as POSSIBLE_FULL_TARGET_CANDIDATE for parent disjoint reviews, definition-first verification and any explicit resource/settlement GO before further acceptance assays. No retry is automatic.
